description: A University of Virginia Biocomplexity group deposits a coarse synthetic population for Finland, version 0.9.0, under CC BY 4.0. Zenodo lists a public data ZIP, README, contact-matrix CSV and validation plots. The README names person, household, residence, activity-location and activity-assignment tables inside the ZIP. It cites United Nations Demographic Yearbook household data, GPW population counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived points of interest. An agent-based infrastructure simulation can use these synthetic households and daily destinations to construct service catchments or evacuation demand assumptions. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the Finland release. A limitation is that the package represents synthetic daily contacts originally intended for epidemic studies, not a measured Finnish travel survey or validated route choice model. Its coarse geographic construction may miss local facilities or peak-hour patterns. The ZIP was not downloaded; person counts, location coordinates and upstream input licences were not checked independently.
